dct_description_sm: Contributors: EROS Data Center.; Geological Survey (U.S.)

Earthshots is a collection of Landsat images and text, designed to show environmental changes and to introduce remote sensing. Earthshots comes from the U.S. Geological Survey's EROS Data Center. Topics cover environmental change in agricultural, desert, disaster, urban, forest, and water locations, including Mount St. Helens, Chernobyl, Phnom Penh, and Antarctica.
Mode of access: World Wide Web.
